title: HomeGuard Roof Settlement Terms by Package
content:
Under the HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, three package terms govern how a roof is treated: the oldest roof age that still settles roof surfacing at replacement cost, the roof materials that settle at replacement cost whatever their age, and whether cosmetic hail damage to a metal roof is excluded.

## Package terms

| Package | Oldest roof age settling roof surfacing at replacement cost (whole years at the term effective date) | Roof materials settling at replacement cost regardless of age | Cosmetic hail damage to a metal roof excluded |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 10 | none | yes |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 12 | none | yes |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 15 | tile or slate | no |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 12 | tile or slate | yes |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 15 | metal; tile or slate | no |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 20 | metal; tile or slate | no |

## Guideline notes

**Roof age limit.** The figure is the oldest roof age, counted in whole years at the policy term effective date, at which roof surfacing still settles at replacement cost. A roof of exactly that age is within the limit; a roof one year older is beyond it.

**Exempt materials.** A roof of a listed material settles at replacement cost regardless of its age. Where the entry reads "none", no material is exempt and the age limit alone applies.

**Cosmetic hail.** Cosmetic damage means hail damage to a metal roof that does not let water in. Where the entry reads "yes", that damage is excluded on the package; where it reads "no", it is not excluded.

## Illustrations (hypothetical roofs)

| Hypothetical roof at the term effective date | Package | Within the age limit | Exempt material | Settles roof surfacing at replacement cost under these terms |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Asphalt, 12 years | HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | yes (12 is the limit) | no | yes |
| Asphalt, 13 years | HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | no | no | no |
| Tile, 30 years | HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | no | yes | yes |
| Metal, 25 years | HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | no | no (metal is not listed) | no |
| Metal, 25 years | HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | no | yes | yes |
| Wood shake, 20 years | HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | yes (20 is the limit) | no | yes |

A hypothetical hail loss that dents a metal roof without letting water in is excluded as cosmetic on HomeGuard HO-3 Essential, HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced and HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced, and is not excluded on HomeGuard HO-3 Premier, HomeGuard HO-5 Premier and HomeGuard HO-5 Signature.
